name: oriso-understand-kit
changelog: 0.2.0 (2026-09-05) — the kit becomes subscribable over HTTP (concept step 7.3). New in the Dreambau app: GET /understand/api/v1/kit/manifest and .../kit/bundle, top-level (not under /testmails), read-only, behind the same machine bearer tokens as the Test-Access API (sha256 hash, timingSafeEqual, expiresAt/revokedAt, no new scope field); the bundle carries an ETag = sha256 of the archive and answers 304 on If-None-Match, 503 bundle_not_built when dist/ is missing. New in the kit: kit-subscribe.sh and install.sh --subscribe (manifest -> version compare -> download -> per-file sha256 verify -> unpack to ~/.oriso-dev-kit/, never blocking, ORISO_KIT_BASE / ORISO_KIT_TOKEN). settings.hook.json now runs kit-subscribe --max-seconds 10 before ua-pull; rules/templates/codex.md documents the same two lines for Codex.

0.1.0 (2026-09-05) — first kit in the dreambau monorepo. Content moved from ORISO '0 - Docs/dev-kit' (install.sh, ua-pull.sh, mcp-add.sh, settings.hook.json, .mcp.json.example, 5 prompts) plus the oriso-graph skill. New: install target ~/.oriso-dev-kit/ with a skill symlink into the repo, tool-neutral rules/AGENTS-block.md as the single source of the working rule, AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / codex.md repo templates, manifest + build-bundle.sh for the subscription endpoint, first feature page (Case Handover). Not included: ua-platform (builder, stays in ORISO Docs) and deep-run (analysis artefacts).
